mode: fresh direct semantic judgment, serialized then replayed; no external judge API invocation
validation: all 90 model/condition/video combinations, GT target coverage, label consistency and exact full-caption evidence checked
limitations: Single nonblind LLM judge; human review informed by these same captions, not held-out.
No source video independently inspected by assistant.
New event timestamps and track IDs unprovided; family recall is not localized instance recall.
Precision/hallucination apply only to reviewed propositions. Unreviewed scene detail is not silently marked correct.
Old and new scores not numerically comparable: GT, action-family policy, precision units, direction scope and weights changed.
